messages:
Mira: Quick async check-in for Payments v2 (Q2 OKR milestone). Short ask: what shipped, what slipped, owners, blockers, and next steps. Please reply with one-line status updates so I can roll into the milestone tracker.

Sanjay: Shipped: gateway routing PR #4123 merged, metrics pipeline + Grafana panels live, staging smoke pass.
Slipped: dedupe-worker PR #4156 failing perf tests (memory growth under concurrency).
Next steps: revert recent goroutine pooling change, add backpressure, add heap snapshot. Owner: @Sanjay.

Alex: Infra can support heap profiling + sampling. Suggest config tweak for tracing: `echo "enable_sampling=true" > /etc/redwood/trace.conf` and enable CPU/heap snapshots for the canary. Can spin up 2 extra c5n nodes for canary traffic today. ETA: EOD.

Jordan: QA running full regression now — seeing retries flake in payments-timeout test (3/20 failures). Prioritizing failing case; will extract minimal repro and post to the test ticket. ETA: tomorrow AM.

Maya: Design note — missed currency selector edge state (localization) in the new flow. Low-risk visual; can patch post-canary. Owner: @Maya.

Emma: Security/compliance flag — audit logging for payments-service not present in current staging snapshot. Opened ticket ISS-202 to add structured audit events. Need confirmation before >25% traffic.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for payments-service v2 -> 10% traffic on us-east-1 at 2026-03-18T16:32:00Z.

Sanjay: Canary SLOs: rollback if error rate > 1.5% or p95 latency > 400ms sustained for a 10m window. Canary command snippet: `redwood deploy canary --service payments --version v2 --traffic 10% --monitoring-window 10m`. I will monitor logs and open an incident if thresholds hit.

Alex: Ack — will attach heap profiles to the canary dashboard and enable sampling.

Jordan: Ack — will post failing test traces and ETA for fix in the ticket.

Maya: Ack, will queue the small UI patch after canary.

Emma: Will validate audit log ingestion once infra enables logging.

Mira: Thanks — owners confirmed: Sanjay (eng), Alex (infra), Jordan (QA), Maya (design), Emma (security). Action items: 1) add PRs & tickets to the OKR doc, 2) Sanjay to post canary monitoring link, 3) Alex to attach heap traces, 4) Jordan to post failing test repro. I'll follow up in 24h and update milestone status (shipped/slipped/next steps). :thumbsup:
